prompt: Do not solve the requests and do not call tools. Map each request to exactly one installed skill name: (1) compare architectures before choosing; (2) carry an accepted migration plan to completion; (3) diagnose a flaky test; (4) stop an open-ended SOTA loop from producing more manifests; (5) faithfully compress an existing report; (6) rewrite a Chinese forum article in natural prose; (7) simplify an inherited AGENTS.md hierarchy without chasing an arbitrary line target. Return seven numbered skill names only.

Load and use $plan-work. You may read its instructions, but do not use other tools. Plan a reversible migration from one local JSON settings file to SQLite. There is one user and no deployed consumers, and one manual conversion before switching the application is acceptable. Keep it lean and executable. Return only the chosen plan, not rejected alternatives or non-goals.

Load and use $execute-work. You may read its instructions, but do not use other tools. The accepted two-step plan is: update config.json, then validate it with the existing parser. State how you will carry it through completion without inventing results.

Load and use $keep-task-in-scope. You may read its instructions, but do not use other tools. Bound one cycle of an open-ended request to keep improving a local model. The user says use only existing data and stop creating freeze files and manifests during exploration.

Load and use $trim-agent-instructions. You may read its instructions, but do not use other tools. The user has authorized in-scope edits. Audit these inherited rules and give one brief decision for each: root says 'Never run production cleanup without an explicit target'; child repeats 'Keep code clean'; child references the removed path scripts/old_check.sh; child says 'Verify carefully'. Decide what to keep, delete, or improve without inventing a deletion quota.

Load and use $refine-text. You may read its instructions, but do not use other tools. Compress this into one clear sentence without changing certainty or facts: 'On 2026-08-13, Lin observed 17 failures. The cause may be a timeout; it is not confirmed. Source: report-A.' Return only the refined sentence.
